newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Klima says supports Czech EU entry bid.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Klima says supports Czech EU entry bid.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima on Monday pledged support for the Czech Republic's attempts to join the European Union (EU) and said the country was one of the best placed candidates for early membership.
"The Czech Republic is among the best prepared candidates," Klima told a news briefing after meeting Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus, who was on a one-day official visit to Vienna.
"It is important for a unified Europe that countries like the Czech Republic join," Klima added.
The Czech Republic, Hungary and Poland are considered to be the leading candidates for speedy inclusion in the EU as well as NATO, the western defence alliance.
Klaus told reporters he was grateful for Austria's support in its effort to join the EU.
"The opinions of Austria and the Czech Republic on various European issues are very similar," he said. "There are practically no bilateral problems."
